ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 70% high-intensity (white) to 30% low-intensity (black) pixels across the visible ventral area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous high-intensity white regions occupy the center of both lobes. Low-intensity black regions are localized at the peduncle junction, trailing margins, and as discrete spots across the right lobe distal surface.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with an approximate internal vertex angle of 38 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude serrations along the trailing edge; right lobe medial edge displays 5-7 distinct prominent sawtooth projections.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edges follow a macro-convex curve. The leading edge of the left lobe follows a linear sweep to the distal tip.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely distributed dark circular pixel clusters mapped across the high-intensity fields, predominantly in the upper half of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Parallel vertical low-intensity linear disruptions visible on the proximal regions of both lobes near the central stem.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive jagged indentations and irregular notches along the trailing edge of both lobes indicating structural tissue loss.
